esg_reason: 주주가 물 사용과 AI 개발에 대한 보고서를 요구하고 있어 환경적 요소가 포함됨.

holder_request.summary: Alphabet Inc.는 물 사용 정책과 AI 개발 관련 보고서를 공개하라는 주주 제안을 제출했다.

evidence.quote: Resolved: Shareholders request that Alphabet Inc. prepare and publicly disclose a report, or disclose analysis which has already been performed, prepared at reasonable expense and omitting proprietary information, detailing how its water usage policies and practices align with its fiduciary duty to maximize long-term shareholder value, particularly in relation to sustaining brand growth and advancing artificial intelligence (AI) initiatives.

company_response.summary: 이사회는 이미 물 사용 전략과 관련된 정보를 충분히 제공하고 있다고 주장하며, 추가 보고서는 불필요하다고 반대하고 있다.

evidence.quote: Our Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal because: • We have a long track record of providing extensive information and already provide details on our water strategy, risks, policies, and usage metrics in our existing environmental reporting.

key_issues.issue: 물 사용 정책과 AI 개발의 연관성에 대한 투명한 보고 필요성

evidence.quote: Water scarcity poses a material risk to Alphabet’s infrastructure and brand reputation, with Alphabet’s sustainability reporting noting that 'in 2024, 72% of our freshwater withdrawals came from sources at low risk of water depletion or scarcity.'
We already provide extensive reporting about our water strategy, disclosing our programs, risks, and usage metrics.

key_issues.issue: 주주가 요구하는 보고서의 필요성과 회사의 기존 보고서의 충분성

evidence.quote: Transparent reporting on these measures will enable investors to evaluate how Alphabet management is (1) prioritizing capital efficiency, (2) practicing genuine stewardship of both environmental resources and enterprise value and risk-adjusted growth.
Preparing a separate, bespoke report as requested by the proponent would be duplicative and inefficient, administratively burdensome, and an ineffective use of our resources.

vote_opinion.reason: 회사가 이미 물 사용과 관련된 정보를 충분히 제공하고 있으며, 추가 보고서는 중복적이고 비효율적일 수 있다.
